title: Fluorinated poly(aryl ether)s containing difluoromethylene and tetrafluoroethylene moieties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47630-47636
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08064A, Paper

Ying Chang, Adi Avi-Izak, Timothy M. Krentz, Matthew Ravalli, Chang Y. Ryu, Chulsung Bae
Novel fluorinated poly(aryl ether)s containing difluoromethylene (–CF2–) and tetrafluoroethylene (–CF2CF2–) segments were synthesized and their polymer properties with counterpart carbonyl [C(O) and C(O)C(O)] containing polymers were studied.
